import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { StringDecoder } from 'node:string_decoder';
import { JobError } from './common.js';
import { ownedSupervisorSource } from './process-supervisor.js';
/** `child` is an owned supervisor; it pins the group/job identity while payloads
 * and descendants are cleaned. Never discovers/kills processes by port/name. */
export class OwnedProcessRegistry {
    children = new Set();
    spawn(file, args, signal, options = {}) {
        signal.throwIfAborted();
        const child = spawn(process.execPath, ['-e', ownedSupervisorSource], { env: { ...process.env, ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: '1' },
            detached: process.platform !== 'win32', windowsHide: true, shell: false, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe', 'ipc'] });
        let reason, escalation, timeout, startup;
        let result, stopping = false;
        let stdout = '', stderr = '', bytes = 0;
        const decoders = { stdout: new StringDecoder('utf8'), stderr: new StringDecoder('utf8') };
        const stop = () => {
            if (stopping || child.exitCode !== null || child.signalCode !== null)
                return;
            stopping = true;
            if (child.connected)
                child.send({ type: 'stop' }, () => { });
            // Normal cleanup is 250ms on POSIX, or guard EOF on Windows. The fallback
            // only addresses our live supervisor handle after its startup/guard bound.
            escalation = setTimeout(() => { if (child.exitCode === null && child.signalCode === null)
                child.kill('SIGKILL'); }, process.platform === 'win32' ? 12000 : 2000);
        };
        const abort = () => { reason = new JobError(409, 'job_cancelled', 'Job cancelled'); stop(); };
        const capture = (chunk, channel) => {
            bytes += chunk.length;
            if (bytes > (options.maxOutputBytes ?? 1024 * 1024)) {
                reason = new JobError(413, 'child_output_limit', 'Child output limit exceeded');
                stop();
                return;
            }
            if (channel === 'stdout')
                stdout += decoders.stdout.write(chunk);
            else
                stderr += decoders.stderr.write(chunk);
        };
        const completion = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            child.stdout.on('data', (b) => capture(b, 'stdout'));
            child.stderr.on('data', (b) => capture(b, 'stderr'));
            child.stdin.on('error', () => { });
            child.on('message', (message) => {
                if (!message || typeof message !== 'object')
                    return;
                const data = message;
                if (data.type === 'started')
                    clearTimeout(startup);
                if (data.type === 'result') {
                    clearTimeout(startup);
                    if (data.error)
                        reason ??= new JobError(502, data.error === 'child_isolation_failed' ? 'child_isolation_failed' : 'child_start_failed', data.error === 'child_isolation_failed' ? 'Unable to initialize child process isolation' : 'Unable to start child process');
                    else if (typeof data.code === 'number' || data.code === null)
                        result = { code: data.code, signal: data.signal ?? null };
                }
            });
            child.once('error', () => { reason = new JobError(502, 'child_start_failed', 'Unable to start child process'); });
            child.once('close', () => {
                stdout += decoders.stdout.end();
                stderr += decoders.stderr.end();
                signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                clearTimeout(startup);
                clearTimeout(escalation);
                this.children.delete(owned);
                if (reason)
                    reject(reason);
                else if (!result || result.code !== 0)
                    reject(new JobError(502, 'child_failed', 'Child process failed'));
                else
                    resolve({ code: result.code, signal: result.signal, stdout, stderr });
            });
        });
        const owned = { child, completion, stop };
        this.children.add(owned);
        void completion.catch(() => { }); // Handler may be aborted before it awaits completion.
        signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
        startup = setTimeout(() => { reason ??= new JobError(502, 'child_start_failed', 'Unable to initialize child process supervisor'); stop(); }, 11000);
        child.send({ type: 'start', file, args, cwd: options.cwd, env: options.env }, error => { if (error) {
            reason ??= new JobError(502, 'child_start_failed', 'Unable to start child process');
            stop();
        } });
        if (options.timeoutMs !== undefined)
            timeout = setTimeout(() => { reason = new JobError(504, 'child_timeout', 'Child process timed out'); stop(); }, options.timeoutMs);
        if (signal.aborted)
            abort();
        return owned;
    }
    async close() { const children = [...this.children]; children.forEach(c => c.stop()); await Promise.allSettled(children.map(c => c.completion)); }
}
//# sourceMappingURL=owned-process.js.map
